get.description: Resolve an immutable skill manifest. Returns ETag: "<digest>". Send If-None-Match with that value for HTTP 304; a missing label never falls back. Optional file_offset/file_limit page the file inventory; follow next_file_offset with the returned version pinned. MCP defaults to 25 files per page and omits frontmatter and file contents; read SKILL.md in chunks for the original metadata.

parameters.name: file_offset
parameters.description: Zero-based file offset. Pin version when following next_file_offset.

parameters.name: file_limit
parameters.description: Files per manifest page (1–25). REST defaults to all files; MCP defaults to 25.
